reason: The pressed regolith blanks need firing before they can make a strong floor, and the solar heating bay suggests where to do it.
expectation: The solar heat will fire the blanks into solid floor material.

effect: The blanks are now ceramic blocks suitable for non-pressure paving, so they can form the growing bay floor.
reaction: The distinction between paving and pressure containment makes physical sense.
reason: The blocks are intended as paving for the cleared growing bay.
expectation: The blocks will make a floor for the pressure liner.

effect: The ceramic blocks have made a level floor, ready for the liner.
reaction: The explanation of bedding the blocks makes the floor preparation feel practical.
reason: The level floor is ready for the folded pressure envelope, so I will try installing it there.
expectation: The envelope will unfold onto the prepared floor.

effect: The envelope cannot yet be combined directly with the level floor, so another preparation may be needed.
reaction: The failed attempt is mildly surprising because the floor appeared ready for the liner.
reason: The felt and clean fabric may form a protective layer between the paving and the pressure envelope; this is a guess.
expectation: The fabric and felt will make a protective underlay for the liner.

alternatives.reason: Checking the floor's available partners could clarify the next fitting.

effect: The felt and fabric made a padded underlay to protect the pressure skin from ceramic edges.
reaction: The extra protective layer explains why the level floor alone was not enough.
reason: The underlay should go on the level floor before the pressure envelope.
expectation: The pad will cover the paving and prepare the floor for the liner.

effect: The padded underlay completed the safe floor, and the new goal is an inhabited, illuminated room.
reaction: The layered floor construction now has a clear purpose.
reason: The protected floor is ready for the folded pressure envelope.
expectation: The envelope will unfold onto the protected floor to form the room.

effect: The pressure envelope is installed and sealed, but the room still needs breathable gas and lighting.
reaction: The separate roles of imported seals and local blocks are clear.
reason: The sealed room needs breathing gas to become inhabitable.
expectation: The gas supply will pressurize the growing room with breathable air.

alternatives.reason: The lights also need installing, but I will establish the atmosphere first.

effect: The growing room is pressurized and leak-checked; it still needs illumination.
reaction: Seeing the envelope lift and the airlock become usable makes the room feel real.
reason: The grow-light rails are the remaining visible equipment for illuminating the room.
expectation: The rails will provide lighting for the growing room.

effect: The light rails completed the illuminated growing room and the chapter's remaining goal.
reaction: The explanation that the array was sized for the lights makes their power supply feel credible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the protected floor was most worthwhile: the ceramic blocks provide support while the padded underlay protects the pressure skin, making the construction understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to install the envelope was mildly confusing because the level floor initially sounded ready for it.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the envelope could not go directly on the level floor; the later underlay explained the need to protect it from ceramic edges.

arbitrary.text: The initial inability to fit the envelope felt arbitrary until the underlay's protective purpose became clear.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical construction details and the growing room taking shape made me curious about what happens next.
